SpessaSynth browser audio assets

spessasynth_processor.min.js is downloaded by setup.bat/start.bat from the
pinned spessasynth_lib 4.3.14 package. It must match the JS library version.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/spessasynth_lib@4.3.14/dist/spessasynth_processor.min.js
